caption: Every action you could possibly add to a page — standard ones like Log a Call and New Task, plus any custom quick action you've built.
The plus icon in the header opens Global Actions — available from anywhere in the org, not tied to any one record.
On a record page, the action overflow menu is scoped to that object — Submit for Approval only makes sense on some records, not every one.
